s316q RE-DIAGNOSED: cluster C's core (with 'Role' installing methods) was ALREADY FIXED — the dist crashes were (1) use-vs-BEGIN compile-stream ordering (%INC seeding idiom) and (2) use-base defclass read-time package dependency, both fixed in 5518570 (Role-Tiny 9/8/6 → 11/8/4). Remaining 4 FAILs: subclass.t = "Can't locate object method apply_roles_to_package via package RoleExtension" (methods inherited from the transpiled Role::Tiny class — @ISA dispatch into a module-loaded parent); proto.t = generated CL read error (bad symbol, find it); concrete-methods.t = stash-entry-forms torture (constants/stubs/glob-stored subs enumeration, likely §live-symbol-table territory); namespace-clean.t = XS dependency (expected-divergence material).

=== s522b MEASURED (member 5): concrete-methods.t is the LOWERING, not the stash view ===
    BEGIN { package R; use constant DEF => 1; my $d = DEF; print "d=$d\n"; } print R::DEF(), "\n";
perl: d=1 / 1.  PCL (base and s522b): d=DEF, then Undefined subroutine &R::DEF.  The `use constant` inside a BEGIN's `package R;` emits an UNQUALIFIED `(p-sub pl-DEF ...)` -- the whole BEGIN is one top-level form READ in main, so it defines main::DEF -- and the bareword DEF in the same block reads as the string.  Fix shape: the use-constant lowering qualifies its sub name when the reader package differs (the block-depth question the @ISA path asks; same family as #3630), and the constant's name joins the parse-time prototype table for the rest of the block.  Cost: one emission site; corpus-diff will show every in-BEGIN constant.

=== QUEUED (s530, Fable, 2026-10-31) ===
One of the 41 REAL whole-file CPAN board failures (the USER-asked review; 138 FAIL files = 69 perl-skips + 4 fixed + 2 perl-fails + 22 ruled not-supported + 41 real).  Queued as s531b member 10 (measure + split) -- `briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s530/s531a-prompt.md` / `s531b-prompt.md`.


=== HANDED BACK (s532c) === (Opus agent, 2026-11-08) -- re-measured only; back to the queue.
Re-measured on main 9c150764 (code ce665621), one-file runs of Role-Tiny-2.002004 (s532c scratch m0/): subclass.t 6/0 and proto.t 5/0 PASS (they carry no board rows -- nothing to edit); concrete-methods.t no TAP rows, rc 255 (*FILE* row unchanged); overload.t 2 ok / 13 not ok (the 13 blessed rows, same got values); role-tiny-with.t row 5 and stub.t rows 2 / 4 unchanged; namespace-clean.t 2/2 -- its rows 2 / 3 are #3632's (B::Hooks::EndOfScope needs XS).
WHERE TO START: overload.t (13 rows, the biggest share): Role::Tiny copies a role's overload handlers into the consuming class through the `(` / `((` stash entries (`*{"${target}::(+"}` etc.) -- probe `package R; use overload '""' => sub {"welp"}; package C; *{"C::(\"\""} = *{"R::(\"\""}; ...` vs perl to see whether PCL's overload table is read from those glob entries at all (it is probably a side table that a glob copy does not reach); concrete-methods.t: "Undefined subroutine &MyRole1::before_constant_deflate" -- a constant-installed sub (use constant inside the role) seen by the composition walk.

=== DONE (s536a) === (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-08) -- overload.t FIXED; the three residues re-keyed to their own tasks.
overload.t 2 ok / 13 not ok -> 14 / 1 (one-file runs, base 06a4b8ba -> tree): perl's overload table IS the stash and `use overload` wrote no stash entry, so Role::Tiny (which composes a role's overloads by enumerating the role's subs: `(""`, `((`, `()`, a method-name handler as \&overload::nil + the name in ${"R::(OP"}) composed none.  Fixed in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp: p-register-overloads also writes the entries (%p-overload-stash-write, overload::nil); %p-glob-overload-entry reads the nil + scalar-name pair in either order; p-glob-copy registers a copied `(OP` glob; %p-glob-rhs-inner = one reading of a glob RHS (a variable holding \$s is the referent -- `my $r = \$s; *y = $r` made $y a REF, a silent wrong on the base too -- and \$g with $g a glob is a GLOB ref).  Guard Pl/t/overload-01.t row 49.
Row 4 'fallback value not overwritten' -> #1915 (fallback => 0 never dies: `0+$o` with only `""` / `0+` handlers lives in PCL, dies "no method found" in perl -- probed without Role::Tiny, scratch/s536a/p/135-6.pl).
stub.t 2 / 4 + role-tiny-with.t 5 -> #4561 (a perl forward declaration `sub NAME;` is hidden from the stash view; a glob copy of \&stub installs a defined sub).
concrete-methods.t *FILE* -> #4562 (`use constant` after `package R;` inside a BEGIN / sub defines main's sub; a constant used later in the SAME BEGIN is a string).  The file has more after these (stubs #4561, a stash element write `$MyRole1::{blorf} = sub {...}` = the deferred live-stash model, constants' stash representation).
#4522 (inherited overload breadth-first) is a different site and was not touched.  No cache of any kind was added: the stash entries are a fact beside *p-overload-table*, read by nothing in dispatch.
